# Kimi Official Tools

Kimi official tools are currently free for a limited time.

Supported models are `kimi-k3`, `kimi-k2.6`, and `kimi-k2.5`.

| Tool Name       | Description              |
| --------------- | ------------------------ |
| `convert`       | Convert formats          |
| `web-search`    | Search the web           |
| `rethink`       | Rethink a problem        |
| `random-choice` | Make a random choice     |
| `mew`           | Mew                      |
| `memory`        | Store memory             |
| `excel`         | Process spreadsheets     |
| `date`          | Process dates            |
| `base64`        | Encode and decode Base64 |
| `fetch`         | Fetch a resource         |
| `quickjs`       | Run JavaScript           |
| `code-runner`   | Run code                 |

Formula `moonshot/web-search:latest` reports resource usage while the platform handles billing; web-search pricing is documented separately.
